scripts.dev: node --eval "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; const s = spawn('node', ['apps/server/src/index.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const w = spawn('./node_modules/.bin/vite', ['apps/web'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); w.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build apps/web
